meaning:
γηράσκω (also γηράω; γῆρας),
[in LXX chiefly for זקן ;]
to grow old: Jhn.21:18, Heb.8:13.†
SYN.: παλαιοῦμαι. (AS)

elsewhere.note: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and…
In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first old. But that which is becoming old and grows aged is near to vanishing away.
